'''Alan Sagan''' won the [[2000 Hoth North Ridge Regionals]].<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher.
